paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文探索将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像识别，把图像切分为固定大小的图像块并作为序列输入 Transformer 编码器 [S1.p3]。作者在 ImageNet、ImageNet-21k、JFT-300M 等大规模数据上预训练，并迁移到多个中小规模识别基准 [S1.p5]。结果显示，大规模预训练下 ViT 在多个基准上达到或超过当时最优卷积网络，且预训练计算资源需求更低 [S1.p5][S4.p1]。作者还进行了掩码图像块预测的自监督初步探索 [S4.SS6.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，而将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与卷积结合，要么替换卷积的某些组件但保留整体结构 [abstract]。作者希望验证对 CNN 的依赖是否必要，即纯 Transformer 直接作用于图像块序列能否在图像分类任务上表现良好 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: In vision, attention is either applied in conjunction with convolutional networks, or used to replace certain components of convolutional networks while keeping their overall structure in place.
We show that this reliance on CNNs is not necessary and a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks.

method.text: 方法上，作者尽可能遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。图像块被当作 NLP 中的词元处理，并额外加入一个可学习的分类标记用于分类 [S1.p3][S3.F1]。此外还提出混合架构，即输入序列可由 CNN 特征图构成 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
In order to perform classification, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable “classification token” to the sequence.
Image patches are treated the same way as tokens (words) in an NLP application.
As an alternative to raw image patches, the input sequence can be formed from feature maps of a CNN.

experiments.text: 实验评估了 ResNet、ViT 和混合模型的表示学习能力，在不同规模的数据集上预训练并在多个基准任务上评测 [S4.p1]。预训练数据包括公开的 ImageNet-21k 和内部的 JFT-300M [S1.p5]。评测基准包括 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-100 以及包含 19 个任务的 VTAB 套件 [S1.p5]。此外还进行了掩码图像块预测的自监督初步实验 [S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate the representation learning capabilities of ResNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), and the hybrid.
To understand the data requirements of each model, we pre-train on datasets of varying size and evaluate many benchmark tasks.
When pre-trained on the public ImageNet-21k dataset or the in-house JFT-300M dataset, ViT approaches or beats state of the art on multiple image recognition benchmarks.
In particular, the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
We also perform a preliminary exploration on masked patch prediction for self-supervision, mimicking the masked language modeling task used in BERT.

findings.text: 主要结论是：在足够规模的数据上预训练后，大规模训练胜过归纳偏置，ViT 在多个图像识别基准上接近或超过当时最优结果 [S1.p5]。ViT 在多数识别基准上达到最优，且预训练计算成本更低 [S4.p1]。自监督预训练下，较小的 ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9% 准确率，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4% [S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: We find that large scale training trumps inductive bias.
Our Vision Transformer (ViT) attains excellent results when pre-trained at sufficient scale and transferred to tasks with fewer datapoints.
When considering the computational cost of pre-training the model, ViT performs very favourably, attaining state of the art on most recognition benchmarks at a lower pre-training cost.

With self-supervised pre-training, our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.

limitations.text: 作者明确承认的局限包括：自监督预训练仍落后监督预训练 4%，对比预训练的探索留待未来工作 [S4.SS6.p1]。此外，AxialResNet 基线实现与开源实现类似，在 TPU 上非常慢，因此无法用于大规模实验 [A4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: We leave exploration of contrastive pre-training to future work.
